title: Where Arthur and his father were born and raised
summary: Arthur was born by the Tremé Market, father born uptown near Burgundy Street, family later moved to Claiborne.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How early did you born? What part of this part of town?
I was born right here on Orleans between Robinson and Dillard, right across from the old Tremé Market.
Your father lived there, do you think, most of his life?
Or where did he come? What part of town did he born here?
He was born up around Liberty Street somewhere. Uptown? Right, right, no, around Burgundy Street somewhere, towards Dumain. Where? That's where he was originally born.
He lived downtown then all his life?

All his life he lived downtown. And we lived on Orleans Street right across from the Tremé Market. That's when I was born. Most of our family, my brothers and sisters, were born right there by the old Tremé Market. Then from there, well, as we got older, the house was smaller, my mother moved further up. That's where we lived on Claiborne Street, I'm telling you. And then that's when my brother got large enough and he started off with a tin flute.
